narration: This is a catalogue, not a comparison. Worth knowing before you read it. [pause] The author sorts fifty tools into three layers. Skills supply procedure. M C P supplies access. Repositories supply the engine that runs things. [pause] In the skills layer, Superpowers bundles test-driven development, debugging and planning. Systematic Debugging insists you find the cause before changing code. Skill Creator turns a workflow you describe into a skill file. File Search combines ripgrep and a s t-grep. Context Optimization is about token spend and cache behaviour. [pause] In the access layer, three picks. Tavily does search, extract, crawl and map. Context7 pulls in current library documentation on request. Task Master turns a product document into dependency-linked tasks. [pause] In the engine layer, LangGraph expresses agents as graphs. CrewAI organises them by role and goal. Ollama runs models locally. And promptfoo tests prompts and security before you ship. [pause] The repository watchlist goes further. Parallel coding with cmux and claude-squad. Persistent memory. Test-first enforcement through T D D Guard. And tracing for agent runs. [pause] Installing is just copying a skill folder into your Claude skills directory, then restarting. [pause] One honest note. The author explicitly asks you to run your own security check. Treat this as a shortlist, not an endorsement.
